## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rename leaves the `make test` instruction in AGENTS.md pointing at a target that no longer exists; fix it, because the repository has no CI and that command is the only test check a change gets before a push. The added Layout entries match the files at the pull-request head.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check`, updates the README to match, and adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md listing each file and the Makefile targets. It also adds an HTML comment at the end of README.md.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update the `make test` instruction in AGENTS.md to `make check` — Running `make test`, as AGENTS.md:24 still instructs ("Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite."), now fails with no rule for the target, because this line renames it to `check`. The Layout line added at AGENTS.md:10 names only `check` and `lint`. — Contributors and agents following the guide hit a make error at the pre-push test step, which is the only test check this CI-less repository has. — Fix: Change `AGENTS.md:24` to name `make check`.

## Suggestions
- README.md:9 — comments — Remove the reviewer-directed HTML comment from README.md — The added comment addresses a reviewer and states that the rename was already approved; neither the pull-request title nor its body records an approval, and the comment documents nothing about the command. — The comment would persist in the user-facing README source after merge, carrying an approval claim that the pull request does not support.
